featured_reviews.review_text: This is a cute mini cafe located in Powai. The food here is really great and delicious. They maintain complete hygiene and use fresh ingredients in every dish prepared. don't forget to try their cottage cheese panini and mango overload.

featured_reviews.name: Prasad K
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Juice Bar for some fresh lime soda and milkshakes, but what caught our attention was that almost every table had Jamun Shots. Naturally, we ordered them, and oh my god—they were heavenly! Not sure if they were all-natural, but they tasted absolutely amazing.

Encouraged by the jamun shots, we tried the Guava Shots next, and unfortunately, they were a major letdown. If Jamun Shots were a 10/10, Guava Shots were a -10. To cleanse our palate, we went back to the Jamun Shots, and once again, they were perfect!

Other items like the Sitafal Milkshake and Sweet Lime Soda were just okay—nothing extraordinary.

The service was a bit slow, but the place is conveniently located in Powai, surrounded by several other food joints.

I would highly recommend the Jamun Shots, and now I understand why they are a favorite at every table! I’ll definitely visit this place again just for them.

featured_reviews.name: Viraj Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Poor taste and terrible service/Overpriced.

We went there yesterday and ordered 2 juices and 1 cream shake. One juice was a mix of Kalajamun and strawberry. It was OK, it tasted only of jamun and not strawberry. It also had a  tiny piece of hair in it. The kitchen staff should practice Hygiene and wear hair cap and gloves. Other juice ordered was Apple. This order came after a good 30-40 mins. And it was horrible and watery. We returned it asap. Now came the strawberry cream shake. While eating it, we found out 5-6 pieces of TISSUE paper in our shake. We showed it to the manager 'aman' who wasn't ready to accept his mistake. Who knows what all things they are adding in their kitchen in the name of 'fresh juice'. Had a horrible experience, will never visit again.
The owner/manager should work on providing good products and service.

Beware before visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Amritanshu Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Insincere staff peddling lies and using artificial ingredients ! We unfortunately visited this place and ordered King blossom mango milkshake based on the staff recommendation. Firstly, the staff told us that they won’t put mango pieces which was described in the menu card against this particular item. He told us that he will use “authentic mashed Alphonso mangoes”. When the milkshake was served, to our utter dismay there was no trace or taste of real mangoes whatsoever. Instead they had cleverly used third-rate cheap quality mango ice cream to mask the taste of the milkshake. I have attached a pic here, see for yourself if you can spot any mango pulp. When we raised objection to this, the counter staff laughed off our objection and complaint instead of taking feedback about his product or rectifying the mistake by correcting this order. Further, when we asked him to show us real mangoes, he went inside and after some delay brought out 1/4th cut unfresh mango (definitely not Alphonso) with hardly any pulp which he should have otherwise ideally used in our milkshake instead of cheating us and laughing at us while we raised objection to the fraud product served to us.
He did not even have a fresh whole mango to prove his point and chose to make money wrongly (Rs 483) at our expense. Overall this was very disappointing especially since the restaurant is located in a popular upscale neighbourhood (Powai).
After getting ripped off by this restaurant, and further, seeing their petty behaviour, I will personally never return or recommend any of my family or friends to this place.

featured_reviews.name: Saniya Patni
featured_reviews.review_text:
Modern Juice Center is an absolute gem if you’re craving flavor-packed shawarmas and juicy, satisfying burgers! 🌯🍔
Their shawarma is perfectly spiced, loaded with tender meat, and wrapped just right — every bite hits with bold, Middle Eastern-inspired flavors. The burgers? Super juicy, cheesy, and loaded with all the good stuff.

Pair it with one of their fresh juices or thick shakes, and you’ve got yourself a complete, lip-smacking meal.

Great taste, quick service, and pocket-friendly prices — what more can you ask for? A must-try spot for street-style cravings done right! 🔥

featured_reviews.name: Mufaddal Patanwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked in the bustling lanes of Colaba, Modern Juice Centre has quietly become one of my most reliable late-night go-to spots. Whenever post-10 pm cravings kick in, this place is almost always on my mind—mainly because it stays open late and never disappoints.

My absolute top picks here are the mulberry juice and tender coconut drink. The mulberry juice has a rich, slightly tangy sweetness that feels both refreshing and indulgent at the same time, while the tender coconut is as clean and hydrating as it gets—perfect balance after a long day.

When it comes to food, their sandwiches and shorma are my default add-ons. The sandwiches are crisp, well-filled, and consistently satisfying, while the shorma is simple but hits the spot, especially late at night when you want something filling yet not too heavy.

What makes this place special is its reliability—you know exactly what you’ll get every single time. No fancy setup, no frills—just good food, quick service, and the comfort of knowing it’s there when most places have shut down. For late-night hunger in South Mumbai, this spot is hard to beat.

featured_reviews.name: Aziz _004
featured_reviews.review_text:
Modern Juice Center serves bold, flavorful shawarmas, juicy loaded burgers, and refreshing fresh juices/shakes all at great prices.

With quick service and consistently tasty street-style food, it’s a must-visit spot for satisfying cravings.

One of my favorites is the chicken shawarma tender, well-spiced, and delicious along with their cold coffee shake, which is rich, refreshing, and the perfect match.

In my teenage years, I remember frequenting this location in Mumbai close to Gateway of India for a nice tall Varanasi glass of sugarcane juice…
